scope: Third focused source review in the current local Windows worktree: RATS provider identity platform branches, platform test gating, Context Engine multi-language parsing dependencies and LSP coverage

findings.summary: RATS executable and live-process identity validation fails open off Windows: the executable check degrades to is_file() and the process check to an os.kill(pid, 0) liveness probe whose PermissionError is treated as a match
still_enforced_off_windows: descriptor parent inside the provider's discovery root
live hello values matching the descriptor

findings.summary: Eleven Windows-only skipif gates plus three in-body platform branches make a published pass/skip total host-specific; the skipped assertions include the G28 identity paths
gated_subjects: RATS provider identity and process-image validation
findings.note: Decorator count is not test count; a gate may cover a parametrized test

findings.summary: tree-sitter is an optional extra that reaches neither install_requires, .[build] nor the PyInstaller spec; a missing import is swallowed and ten languages silently fall back to regex
findings.pin_checker_scope: Compares setup.py's treesitter group against requirements.txt pins; asserts nothing about parsing behavior
findings.packaged_coverage: Determined by the build machine's venv state under --reuse-venv; the spec does not pin it. Not re-packaged or inspected in this pass.

findings.summary: zig is dead configuration: claimed by can_parse with no grammar dependency and no parse path in either the tree-sitter or the regex mode, yielding an empty result with no error
findings.collateral: The _get_parser chain also retains a 'python' branch although .py is handled by the native python_parser.py

findings.summary: The optional LSP bridge defines six servers; Java, C#, Lua and GDScript are never discovered even when a server is installed
findings.impact_boundary: LSP is an optional enhancement; missing definitions do not affect baseline retrieval

runtime_reproduction.subject: TreeSitterParser instantiated against an isolated temporary directory

typescript_probe.source: one exported function and one exported class

runtime_reproduction.consequence: The locally reproduced 1761 passed / 1 skipped Python regression ran with tree_sitter absent, so only the regex fallback was exercised

negative_results: No TODO/FIXME/HACK markers for unfinished implementations in the Python core or Desktop source
NotImplementedError appears only on legitimate abstract bases, not as a placeholder
No inert 'coming soon' entry points in the renderer; @ / slash candidate, mode menu and command palette empty states correspond to real empty data
not_performed: Reproducing G28/G29 on a Linux or macOS host
Installing the treesitter extra to compare syntax-tree against regex extraction
Re-packaging dist/reverie.exe to inspect whether grammar bindings are bundled
Re-running or rewriting any existing regression totals

documentation.checker_boundary: Offline relative file/heading check; external URLs are not fetched and local artifact references are reported separately
